bias.en: Uptrend, weakening · lost the 30-day and the $184.5 Oct 16 low
bias.zh: 上升趋势、走弱 · 跌破 30 日均线和 10月16日低点 $184.5

read.en: Palantir fell 6.3% on Oct 30 to $184.11 (range $183.68–193.92). It is below the falling 5-day ($194.98) and 10-day ($195.63) and the rising 30-day ($194.24), and above the rising 100-day ($162.42) and 200-day ($153.57). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, still above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($203.12), and RSI is 42.
read.zh: Palantir 10月30日下跌 6.3%，收于 $184.11（区间 $183.68–193.92）。股价低于下行的 5 日（$194.98）和 10 日均线（$195.63）以及上行的 30 日均线（$194.24），高于上行的 100 日（$162.42）和 200 日均线（$153.57）。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$203.12），RSI 为 42。

read.en: The drop broke the $193.1–196.2 support (10 and 30-day), the $189.4–190.6 lows and, on the close, the $184.5 Oct 16 low, all now resistance. Resistance is $184.5–186, then $189.4–190.6 and $194.2–195.6 (5, 10 and 30-day). Support is $182–183.7 (Oct 30 and Sep 22 lows), then $176.8 (Sep 21 low) and $162.4–164.6 (100-day, Sep 10 low). A close above $186 would target $190; below $182, $177.

r.en: Oct 16 low $184.45, lost; Sep 29 low $184.8; Oct 16 close $186.0
